objective:
Add in-app LOGIN (with TOTP) and wire the app shell so the accounts+agents app is self-contained in services/agents-ui. CLIENT-only; no backend or ci.yml changes. Uses the shared auth-api client `@/lib/authApi` and the existing cookie/CSRF web auth (vue-web-commons useAuth). Follow established patterns (inspect merged src/features/account, src/features/signup, src/features/projects/components/CreateProjectForm.vue for useFormErrors). Match all antfu lint rules already established in this repo (import grouping: `import type` first, then external [primevue/* before vue] before `@/` internal before relative; case-insensitive named sort; lowercase describe; function-property interface methods; `new TypeError` for type-guard throws; `} catch {`/`} else {` one-line; `;` member delimiters; vue/max-len 120; no '/api/v1' literals / window.location backend discovery in feature code; useFormErrors() for FormErrors/FormField; child optional props receiving string|undefined declared `?: string | undefined`; explicit arg to vitest mockResolvedValue; fresh Response per fetch mock).

Auth-api (cookie/session) endpoints via the auth-api client:
  - POST /auth/session-login  body { username: string; password: string; totpCode?: string }  -> SessionLoginResponse { success: boolean; totpRequired: boolean; user?: { id; username; email; firstName; lastName; role; roles: string[] } }
  - POST /auth/logout -> 204/200

1) AUTH FEATURE (src/features/auth/): 
   - services/authLoginService.ts: sessionLogin({username,password,totpCode?}) and logout() via the auth-api client.
   - views/LoginView.vue (route /login, PUBLIC): username + password form (useFormErrors + FormField); on submit call sessionLogin. If response.totpRequired (and no code yet), reveal a TOTP code field and resubmit with totpCode. On success: call useAuth().fetchUser() to hydrate the cookie session, then router.push the `redirect` query param (sanitized to a path) or { name: 'sessions' } default. Link to /register and /forgot-password. Surface AuthApiError via useFormErrors/Toast.
   - routes.ts: default FeatureRouteModule { feature: 'auth', routes: [{ path: '/login', name: 'login', component: () => import('./views/LoginView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: false } }], navigation: [] }.
   - tests: authLoginService maps endpoints; LoginView submits, handles totpRequired two-step, redirects on success, shows error.

2) GUARD -> IN-APP LOGIN (src/router/guard.ts): change the unauthenticated redirect from the external `${VITE_AUTH_URL}/login` window.location redirect to an IN-APP redirect: the guard should return a route location `{ name: 'login', query: { redirect: <attempted fullPath> } }` (vue-router supports returning a RouteLocationRaw from beforeEach). Update ProtectedRouteGuardTarget/return type to accept the attempted route fullPath + name (so the guard can avoid redirect-looping when already heading to 'login') and return `boolean | RouteLocationRaw`. Keep public routes (requiresAuth false) passing through untouched, and keep the admin-capability denial behavior. Update src/router/index.ts wiring + any guard tests accordingly. Preserve the existing guard unit tests' intent (unknown/restored/failed restoration, capability) — update them to assert the in-app login redirect location instead of a window.location call.

3) APP SHELL NAV (src/layouts/AppShell.vue): build the CommonsAppShell `:nav-items` from the route-module navigation instead of the fully-hardcoded list: import `navigationItems` and `filterNavigation` from `@/router/navigation`, compute the current auth state from useAuth (isAuthenticated + hasCapability = (cap) => cap === 'admin' && user.role === 'ADMIN'), filter, and map each NavigationItem -> AppShellNavItem ({ label, to (resolve named route via router or use the route name/path), testid: `nav-${id}`, icon }). PRESERVE the existing Sessions entry's child tabs (Workspace/Scratch/Chat) and the new-action ('New session'); the cleanest approach: keep the Sessions item (with its children + the existing /sessions?tab=... links) and APPEND the discovered nav items that are not the sessions/projects/repositories primaries already shown — OR fully map from navigationItems and special-case attaching the Sessions children to the sessions item. Account must appear for authenticated users and Admin (Users) only for ADMIN. Add a logout action (call useAuth().logout() then router.push({name:'login'})) using whatever user-menu/logout slot CommonsAppShell provides (inspect AppShellNavItem / CommonsAppShell props; if there's an existing logout mechanism, use it). Keep the shell working for the existing sessions/projects/repositories routes.

Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint`, `test`, `build`. Do NOT break existing router tests (src/router/__tests__) or the App.test.ts; update them where the guard/redirect contract changed. Keep web cookie auth behavior intact (login establishes the same session cookie; restoration via useAuth().fetchUser()).
